head.description: Streets is an app for reading Nostr posts. Turn Home, notifications, search and more into columns and line them up in the order you like.

nostr.title: Use it with a Nostr account
nostr.lead: Streets is built on Nostr, a shared standard for decentralized social networks. Your posts are stored on servers called relays, so you can read them from many different apps.

otherApps.title: Works in other apps too
otherApps.body: You can sign in to other Nostr apps with the same account, and the list of people you follow comes with you.

findRelays.title: Finds where people post
findRelays.body: Streets looks up the relays the people you follow post to, and reads from them.

columns.title: Line up what you want to see
columns.lead: Add Home, notifications, search and more as columns.

custom.title: Easy to read, easy to use
custom.lead: Change the color theme and keyboard shortcuts to suit you.

keyboard.title: Use the keyboard too
keyboard.moveToColumn: Jump to the 1st to 9th column from the left
keyboard.openPalette: Find and open features by name
keyboard.changeKeys: Change the keys for common actions

others.title: And more
others.timeTravel: Travel back to the date of a post and look through the timeline around it
others.pip: Show a column in picture-in-picture so you can keep reading while you have another window open

choose.heading: Get started
choose.browseHint: You can read posts in the other columns without signing in.

new.title: Get started with Nostr
new.description: We'll walk you through creating an account

existing.title: I already have an account
existing.description: Sign in with your current Nostr account

browse.title: Read without signing in
browse.description: You don't need an account just to look at posts

extension.title: Sign in with an extension
extension.description: Ask a browser extension such as nos2x or Alby to sign for you

remote.title: Sign in with a remote signer
remote.description: Ask another app that holds your key, such as Amber or Primal, to sign for you

login.approve: Approve the connection in your signer

newcomer.intro: On Nostr, your secret key is the key to your account. Keep it safe, never show it to anyone, and don't lose it. Streets doesn't store your secret key. It works through a dedicated app or extension instead.

steps.getApp: Get an app that stores your secret key.
steps.createAccountInApp: Open the app and follow its prompts to create an account.
steps.remoteLogin: Go back to Streets, press "Open in this device's signer" under "Sign in with a remote signer", and approve in the app.
steps.getExtension: Get an extension that stores your secret key.
steps.createAccountInExtension: Open the extension's settings and create an account (key).
steps.extensionLogin: Go back to Streets and press "Sign in with an extension".

newcomer.pcAlternative: If you'd rather not install an extension, create an account in a phone app and scan the QR code under "Sign in with a remote signer" to sign in.
newcomer.keyWarning: If you lose the secret key made by an app or extension, you can never get it back. Follow its prompts to make a backup.
newcomer.done: Account created? Continue to sign in

remote.wayLabel: How to connect to a remote signer

bunker.label: String starting with bunker://
bunker.note: Paste the string starting with bunker:// that your signer shows.
bunker.secretKey: This is a secret key. Streets doesn't accept secret keys, because if one ever leaks there is no way to recover the account. Store your secret key in an extension or signer, then sign in with that.
bunker.secretKeyReason: Why you should never share your secret key

connect.waiting: Scan this with your signer app and approve. Waiting for approval…
connect.resumed: Waiting for approval of the connection you opened earlier. If you approved it in your signer app but it still isn't connected, open it again with "Open in this device's signer".
connect.failed: Couldn't connect to your signer. It wasn't approved in time, or the connection dropped.

diagram.label: One account used with Streets and other apps, with posts from every app stored on relays
